mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' published fast/slow dual-ROC consensus newly becoming unanimously positive or negative on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a multi-band directional transition; follow the consensus for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on the first decision where both two-bar ROCs are strictly positive after the prior decision was not unanimously positive; short symmetrically when both become strictly negative after not unanimously negative
mechanism.why_distinct: The strategy SuperSmooths close at 20, separately high-pass filters it at 55 and 156, takes two-decision momentum of each band, and requires same-sign consensus. It is not the RMS Cybernetic Oscillator, a single zero-cross, moving-average crossover, raw return sum, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: multi-band directional agreement must newly emerge while completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation ranks in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse dual recursive-band momentum-consensus transitions are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.super_smoother: published 20-period recursive SuperSmoother of completed close
features.fast_roc: 55-period high-pass of SuperSmoother minus its two-decision lag
features.slow_roc: 156-period high-pass of SuperSmoother minus its two-decision lag
features.event: new entry into strict same-sign ROC consensus relative to immediately prior valid decision
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: all recursive state resets after any invalid completed four-hour bar; event requires uninterrupted current and prior consensus states

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published Ehlers SS20/HP55/HP156 two-bar dual ROC consensus under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, recursion, lag, consensus, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, Making A Better Oscillator, Simple Dual ROC Strategy, TASC June 2025
external_basis.fixed_definition: SuperSmoother length=20; high-pass lengths 55 and 156; ROC is current high-pass minus lag two; published long condition ROC1>0 and ROC2>0; symmetric negative consensus used for short direction
external_basis.selection_use: published parameters, recursions, two-bar ROC, and positive consensus; negative consensus is the exact sign-symmetric short counterpart; no incidence or outcomes
